dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: People living on this island, please open your eyes and look around you!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: If the Ogosho is so mighty and invincible, why does she not face your questioning in person?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Why does she let our young people die for her and let us torment each other?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Look! Your Ogosho has been blinded. When has she cared about your predicament?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We are the victims of the Vision Hunt Decree. We suffer the same frustrations in this chaotic world as you do!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Brothers and sisters, please join hands with us! Let us bravely make our voice heard by the Ogosho!
